<h2>Build Cumulative sjSDM Tuning Work Items</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Expands staged tuning through the first unfinished round while preserving
deterministic work-item identities from all completed rounds. A later
round is included only when the preceding tier-wide survivor decision is
available.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_sjsdm_cumulative_tuning_work_items(
  data_work_items = NULL,
  data_schedule = NULL,
  list_prior_decisions = base::list()
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_work_items">data_work_items</code></td>
<td>
<p>Complete work-item table returned by [build_sjsdm_tuning_work_items()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_schedule">data_schedule</code></td>
<td>
<p>Staged schedule returned by [build_sjsdm_tuning_schedule()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="list_prior_decisions">list_prior_decisions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Ordered list of consecutive tier-wide decision tables, beginning with
round one. An empty list authorizes round one only.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Cumulative work-item tibble through the first authorized unfinished round.
Existing 'work_item_id' values are preserved for dynamic-branch reuse.
</p>

</main>
